topic_zh: 《逆袭架构师》第1集：一千万人涌进来（估算 QPS）
topic_en: The Comeback Architect, Ep. 1: Ten million people at once (estimating QPS)

xhs.title: 实习生一道算术题，推翻了技术总监
xhs.body:
顶流直播带货，预计 1000 万人来看，每人约 10 次请求。
技术总监：1 亿次请求 ÷ 一天 86400 秒，才 1000 多 QPS，一台服务器够了。
实习生小满：平均值会骗人！人是 8 点同时涌进来的——
按 10 分钟高峰算：1 亿 ÷ 600 秒 ≈ 17 万 QPS，差了一百多倍。
估算 QPS 三步：总请求 → 除以高峰秒数 → 除以单机 QPS 再多留余量，建议收藏～
考考你：100 万人一分钟内涌进来，每人请求 6 次，峰值 QPS 大约多少？A 一万，B 十万？评论区告诉我～

linkedin.title: Averages lie: how to estimate peak QPS.
linkedin.body:
A live sale expects 10 million viewers, about 10 requests each. Dividing 100M requests by 86,400 seconds gives ~1,157 QPS, and a plan for one server.
But everyone arrives at 8 PM. Put those requests in a 10-minute window: 100M ÷ 600 s ≈ 170,000 QPS. Over 100× more.
Three steps: total requests, divide by the peak window, divide by per-server QPS and add headroom (30–50% is common).
Quick quiz: 1M people arrive within one minute, 6 requests each. Peak QPS: A) 10,000 or B) 100,000?

quiz.q_zh: 一百万人一分钟内涌进来，每人请求六次，峰值 QPS 大约多少？A 一万，B 十万
quiz.q_en: 1M people arrive within one minute, 6 requests each. Peak QPS: A) 10,000 or B) 100,000?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：B。100 万 × 6 = 600 万次请求，按一分钟内均匀到达估算：600 万 ÷ 60 = 10 万 QPS。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: B. 1M × 6 = 6M requests; spread evenly over 60 seconds, 6M ÷ 60 = 100,000 QPS.
